title: page
description: An HTML page made from its own data: a Nunjucks template, the model it renders and the partials it includes, in one file. Opened, the template is rendered with the model inside a sandboxed frame and its output is the page shown; nothing is read from beside the file and nothing writes to it.

title.description: Not drawn — the page is what shows. The page's name, and the frame's accessible name.

description.description: Not drawn. A one-line summary of the page, read and kept on a dump.

model.description: The data the template renders. Every key is a variable of the template and of every partial; a value is the YAML as written — text, a number, a boolean, a list, a mapping, and a date as the text it is written as.

partials.description: The templates that `include`, `import`, `from … import` and `extends` name, by name — written here, so the page names no other file.

additionalProperties.description: A Nunjucks template, as a block string.

template.description: The Nunjucks template whose output is the page: `{{ }}` writes a value, `{% %}` is a tag, `|` applies a filter; output is escaped unless the `safe` filter says otherwise. A `<!doctype html>` is put first when the output starts with none.
